parts.label: ButtonGroup root layout contract
upstream_facts: ButtonGroup root uses flex layout.
ButtonGroup root is w-fit by default.
ButtonGroup root uses items-stretch.
Direct input children become flex-1.
Nested button groups add gap-2.
fret_facts: Fret has stable Button Group root selectors in the UI Gallery seed snippets.
The existing seed gates assert selected child bounds but do not yet mechanically compare every root source fact.

checks.expected: Automatically compare root fit/stretch/direct-input flex behavior against Fret layout sidecars.

promotion.reason: If direct child flex/stretch semantics drift across components, the owner is layout vocabulary or layout-tree interpretation rather than a Button Group-only recipe.

parts.label: Button Group input example search button
upstream_facts: The example renders Input followed by an outline Button containing SearchIcon.
ButtonGroup direct input participates in flex-1 sizing.
The icon-only default-size Button keeps compact inline padding rather than becoming size=icon.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery snippet exposes a stable search button test id.
The render-flow seed gate asserts search button width between 36px and 56px and height at least 32px.
The diagnostics seed script repeats min and max bounds assertions and captures layout and screenshot evidence.

checks.expected: Search icon button keeps compact default Button inline padding inside ButtonGroup.

promotion.reason: The invariant is shadcn Button recipe sizing inside a ButtonGroup docs-path composition.

parts.label: Button Group select example composition
upstream_facts: The example renders a monospace currency Select trigger, an amount Input, and an icon-only send Button.
The Select trigger keeps compact control chrome instead of collapsing to text width.
The amount input stretches in the shared lane while the send button stays compact.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery snippet exposes stable test ids for the select trigger, amount input, and send button.
The render-flow gate can assert each sub-control after scrolling the Button Group select section into view.
The diagnostics seed script captures a select-specific layout sidecar and screenshot.

checks.expected: Currency trigger keeps compact monospace select trigger sizing inside ButtonGroup.

promotion.reason: The currency trigger sizing is recipe-level select chrome inside the ButtonGroup select docs-path example.
